summary: Phase 4 backend check of the unified natal PDF service (services/natal_book_service.py). Backend starts with no ImportError; /api/health returns 200; POST /api/astrology/v3/natal/pdf and GET /api/reports/theme-natal/pdf return 401 without auth and 401 with a bogus token (public URL). natal_book_service exposes generate_enriched_natal_pdf and IncompleteNatalDataError. theme_natal_oneshot_service source contains 'from services.natal_book_service import' (checked with inspect.getsource). routes/astrology_v3.py natal_pdf_v3 and routes/reports.py _generate_pdf('theme-natal') both import and call the unified service. pytest: 36/36 passed across the 4 requested files. The counts differ from the request: the request said 26 tests for test_natal_pdf_adapter_no_fallback + test_natal_manuscript_enriched, but only 5 + 11 = 16 are collected; integration has 5 and no_birth_time has 15. So the total is 36, not 46. This is a counting mistake in the request, not missing tests that failed. No real PDF was generated, as instructed.

minor.issue: Premium users get free credits when generation fails. The return value of charge_or_premium is ignored, and every failure path calls add_credits(80, tx_type='refund'). Premium users are never charged (charged=False), so a failed generation still credits them 80. Fix: keep charge = await charge_or_premium(...) and refund only if charge['charged']. Probably pre-existing, but the refactor kept it, and require_complete=True makes failures (and so refunds) more likely.

When payload.person is provided, no_birth_time is always False. PersonInput has no no_birth_time field and hour defaults to 12. A user who submits a person without a known birth time gets a wrong ascendant and wrong houses, which is the exact case the refactor meant to handle.

The digital page count is inflated. diag['pdf_pages'] = pdf_bytes.count(b'/Type /Page') also matches '/Type /Pages' (page tree nodes), so it is at least +1. Use pypdf PdfReader the same way as interior_pages. This only affects diagnostics and metrics.

action_items: astrology_v3.natal_pdf_v3: refund the 80 credits only when charge_or_premium returned charged=True
Optional: add no_birth_time to PersonInput (or NatalRequest) and pass it through in natal_pdf_v3
Optional: count digital PDF pages with pypdf instead of byte-pattern counting
critical_code_review_comments: Unification is correct: all 3 entry points call generate_enriched_natal_pdf; oneshot uses output='print' and the 80cr routes use output='digital'.

The helpers in natal_book_service catch exceptions and log warnings (enhanced analysis, AI, book, chart). If book enrichment fails, book_data=None is passed with require_complete=True, so the adapter is expected to raise. This is covered by the no_fallback tests.
routes/reports.py turns IncompleteNatalDataError into ValueError. Check that the caller of _generate_pdf refunds credits consistently (not verified, out of scope).
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is missing; auth flows were not tested (only 401 checks), per the request
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified natal PDF service validated through unit and integration tests plus 401 checks on the public URL. Real PDF generation was not tested (needs external astrology-api.io and auth). Pre-existing Stripe checkout tracebacks appear in backend.err.log and are unrelated.
